# Median return per period (`median_return`)

*Category: Return summary · Nature: estimated · Unit: decimal_return · Formula id: `median_return@v1` · Methodology 0.1.0*

## 1. What does it measure?

Middle value of the per-period returns.

## 2. Formula

```text
median(r_t)
```

## 3. Required inputs

Periodic simple returns.

## 4. Is higher or lower better?

Higher is better.

## 5. Plain-language interpretation

Half of the periods did better than this and half did worse.

## 6. Professional interpretation

Robust location estimate, insensitive to a few extreme periods. A median well above the mean indicates occasional large losses (negative skew).

## 7. Assumptions

- None beyond the general inputs.

## 8. When can it be misleading?

- Many periods have identical or zero returns.

## 9. Minimum sensible data

One observation; low confidence below 3 years. (policy `location`: Mean-type estimates: low confidence below 3 years, moderate below 5 years.)

## 11. Sources

- Bacon, C. R. (2021). Practical Risk-Adjusted Performance Measurement (2nd ed.). Wiley.

## 12. OpenFactsheet convention

Sample median (average of the two middle values when n is even).
